briefdescription.para: Base entity for clinic-owned clinical records (patients, visits, reports, ...).

detaileddescription.para: Case extends the generic Entity with a fixed organisation name ("clinics") and a family of static permission-query builders. Each builder writes a SELECT that finds out who owns, administers or works at the clinic responsible for a record, so PermissionManager can decide whether a requester may create, read, update or delete that record. Concrete record entities inherit from Case and expose these builders.

WHY THIS FILE MATTERS IN THE SERVER: Clinical records are owned by clinics, not by individual users, so ordinary table-level permissions are not enough. PermissionManager calls the queries produced here to discover the owning clinic's owner_id, admin_id and staff list before authorising an action. Without Case, every clinical entity would have to duplicate this ownership lookup and the server could not enforce "only clinic staff may see this patient's data".

CONCEPTS TO LEARN (for beginners):
std::optional: https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/utility/optional
Static member function: a function that belongs to the class, not to an object, so it can be called as Class::function() without constructing anything.
SQL JOIN: combines rows from two tables using a related column (here clinic id); a LEFT JOIN keeps rows from the first table even if no match exists in the second.
SQL parameter binding: put $1, $2, ... markers in the SQL and pass the real values separately; see https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp or the libpqxx documentation. (These particular queries are the exception: they use only internal, trusted ids and table names.)
